quests.title: The North Gate
quests.description:
Bloodwarden Ashgrym has a sealed report from Elder Torgun for Overseer Durgash Stonejaw, who runs Orgrimmar's half of the dig at Talrendis Landing. The new gate out of the canyon north of the Valley of Honor opens onto Azshara.

The Warchief wants to know what the elves are pulling out of the ground, and he wants to know before they do.

objectives.label: Bring the report to Overseer Durgash Stonejaw in Talrendis Landing

quests.accept_text: Out the north gate and up through the forest. The Landing's on the point to the west. Don't let the elves see the seal, they'll want to read it.
quests.turn_in_text:
Torgun's seal, and the Warchief's questions underneath it. They're the same questions I've been asking for a month.

Welcome to the Landing. Don't trust anything that comes out of the ground until it's been counted twice.

on_accept.name: Torgun's Sealed Report
on_accept.description: A report sealed with Elder Torgun's mark. It's mostly questions.

quests.title: Boar for the Mess
quests.description: Grunt Mazkar says the mess is short of meat and the Provisioner won't cook elf food for orcs. The russet boars root all over the forest outside the gate.
quests.accept_text: The boars are thick in the trees all round the Landing. Bring the haunches back here and Dana will do the rest. She's from somewhere called the North Sea and she can cook anything.
quests.turn_in_text: That's a proper dinner. The elves will complain it's too much meat, and then they'll eat it anyway. Dana says back home on her rig the meat came frozen in boxes, so she's thrilled.

quests.title: Wolves on the Road
quests.description:
Every Autumn Timber Wolf in the forest has taken to following the supply carts out of the Landing, and twice now they've had a driver.

Mazkar wants them taught to stay off the road. Half the drivers are newcomers who'd never seen a wolf before the Integration.
quests.accept_text: Autumn Timber Wolves run the forest between here and the crossroads. Thin them out. They'll learn, or they'll stop needing to. The Autumn Timber Wolves are clever, but they aren't that clever.
quests.turn_in_text: The carts got through clean this morning. You've done the drivers a favour they won't thank you for, because they'll never know.

quests.title: Plumes for the Pillows
quests.description: Layla Saleh and her brother ran a guesthouse on the Red Sea before the Integration. She says the beds at the Landing are a disgrace, and the cliff hippogryphs drop the best feathers she's ever seen.
quests.accept_text: The cliff hippogryphs nest up on the Ursolan heights, north of here. Bring me the plumes and I'll make pillows an elf can't complain about. Well, not much.
quests.turn_in_text:
These are beautiful. In Aqaba I had down from Turkey, and it wasn't this good.

The magisters will sleep better, and I'll get less complaining at breakfast.

quests.title: Ghosts in His Dreams
quests.description:
Half the Landing dreams of the same street every night: a white marble boulevard running into the sea, with people in it who don't see you. Layla's brother Mohammed dreams it every night, and he thinks it's the Drowned Promenade on the coast.

Layla wants someone to go and look, so she can tell her guests it's a real place. They came through three years ago, and she's learned to take her brother's dreams seriously since.

objectives.label: Walk the Drowned Promenade on the East Azshara coast

quests.accept_text: East, past Stormwatch and down to the shore. The Promenade's the marble road that runs into the sea. Tell me if there are people in it, and tell me if they see you.
quests.turn_in_text:
They saw you? Then they're not dreams, they're ghosts, and they're calling.

I'll tell my guests to sleep with the lamps lit. It won't help, but it'll make them feel better.

quests.title: Two Lists
quests.description:
Overseer Durgash keeps one list of everything that comes out of the dig at the Ruins of Eldarath, and Magister Brightspire keeps the other. They never match.

Durgash wants someone with no side to walk the dig and see what's in the trenches before either of them counts it.

objectives.label: Walk the dig at the Ruins of Eldarath in Central Azshara

quests.accept_text: Eldarath's in Central Azshara, south of the lake, east of here. Walk the trenches, see what's lying in them, and come back and tell me before you tell the elves.
quests.turn_in_text:
Crates, columns, and a lot of stone with writing on it nobody can read. That's what I've got on my list too.

So either the elves are lying, or something's walking off before anyone counts it. Three years I've run digs for Orgrimmar, and this is the first one that frightens me.

quests.title: The Road to Eldarath
quests.description:
The carts from the dig come back light, and the drivers say it's satyrs. Haldarr's rogues come down out of their encampment and cut the ropes while the carts climb.

Durgash wants the road cleared, and he wants the satyrs to know who cleared it. Half the drivers are newcomers from Earth, and they didn't sign on to fight satyrs.
quests.accept_text: Haldarr Rogues come down from the encampment in the south-east of West Azshara. Go up there and make them regret every crate they've cut loose.
quests.turn_in_text:
The carts came back full yesterday. Full, and the count still doesn't match the elves'.

So it isn't the satyrs. Not only the satyrs.

quests.title: Who Took the Relic?
quests.description:
The crews found a Highborne key in the trenches, gold and moonstone, as long as your arm. It was on both lists on Monday. On Tuesday it was on neither.

Durgash thinks the elves have it. The elves think he sold it. Dr. Okafor works for both, and Durgash wants you to ask her what she saw.

objectives.label: Bring Durgash's tally to Dr. Amara Okafor at the dig

quests.accept_text: Take my tally to Dr. Okafor. She's down in the dig, usually up to her knees in it. She's the only one here both sides will talk to.
quests.turn_in_text:
I saw it come up, and I saw it go into the crate. Then the crate went into the yard, and the next morning the crate was soaked through with seawater.

Neither the orcs nor the elves took it. Something came up from the sea.

on_accept.name: Durgash's Tally
on_accept.description: Every crate from the last fortnight, counted twice and initialled.

quests.title: The Overseer's Report
quests.description:
With the relic back and the naga's dig on the map, Durgash has a report for Orgrimmar that he doesn't want to write. The relics are keys, the naga want them, and the palace they open is coming up out of the sea.

He wants Elder Torgun to read it from someone who's seen it.

objectives.label: Bring Durgash's report to Elder Torgun in Orgrimmar

quests.accept_text: Take it to Elder Torgun in Orgrimmar, the north gate's quickest. Tell him what you've seen. He'll believe you before he believes me.
quests.turn_in_text:
A palace under the sea, and a queen the night elves say drowned ten thousand years ago. Durgash isn't one to make things up.

The Warchief will want it opened, and he'll want our people first through the door.

on_accept.name: Durgash's Report
on_accept.description: A thick report in Durgash's square hand. He pressed hard enough to tear the paper.

quests.title: The Tidelord
quests.description:
Grunt Mazkar has orders from the Overseer. The naga in the Drowned Palace answer to Tidelord Vashj'ren, and his warriors are the ones who took the relic off our yard. He sits on a coral throne in the palace's flooded halls, with the sea all round him.

Durgash wants the Warchief's answer delivered in person.
quests.accept_text: The palace's door is at the head of the Drowned Court, off the East Azshara shore. Get through the flooded halls to his throne and put him down. You'll want friends with you, a lot of them.
quests.turn_in_text: The Tidelord's dead and the halls are ours. Orgrimmar will hear about this, and so will the elves, and they'll both pretend it was their idea.

quests.title: Shades in the Trenches
quests.description:
Rukka's crews won't work the deep trenches at Eldarath after dark, because the Highborne dead come up out of them looking for what was theirs.

She wants the Eldarath Shades put back down so the night shift can dig. Two of her diggers are from Earth, and they say back home the ghosts at least stayed in the stories.
quests.accept_text: The Eldarath Shades walk the ruins all round the dig, south of the lake in Central Azshara. They're dead already, so you won't feel bad. My crews will do the rest.
quests.turn_in_text: The night shift dug three new trenches in one night. I haven't seen them work that hard since we left Durotar.

quests.title: Crab Season
quests.description: Layla promised the dig crews a crab boil after the big lift, and Dana Whitfield, who cooked on a North Sea rig before the Integration, says she knows how to do it properly. The shorecrabs on Southridge Beach are the size of shields.
quests.accept_text: Southridge Beach is the south coast of Central Azshara. Crack the Southridge Shorecrabs and bring the meat back here. Dana's got the pot on already, and I've promised everyone.
quests.turn_in_text: Dana says back home in Scotland they'd charge a fortune for these. Here they just walk up the beach and try to cut your toes off.

quests.title: Cores for the Crane
quests.description: The Conclave's crane at the dig runs on arcane cores, and the elves won't spare theirs for orc lifts. Rukka has noticed the Eldarath Constructs have cores of their own.
quests.accept_text: The Eldarath Constructs stomp round the ruins near the dig. Break them open and bring me their cores. The elves can't say no to a crane that runs on Highborne parts.
quests.turn_in_text: The crane's running and the elves are furious. Best day I've had since we got here. Dr. Okafor says on Earth they'd put a crane like this in a museum.

quests.title: The Lost Crew
quests.description:
One of Rukka's crews went up the coast to Hetaera's Clutch to salvage a spire that washed up there, and they haven't come back. The naga have a beachhead on the Clutch.

Rukka wants her crew, or she wants to know.
quests.accept_text: Hetaera's Clutch is the headland past the Bay of Storms, north-east Central Azshara. The Stormbay Tidehunters hold the beach. Break them, and look for my crew.
quests.turn_in_text:
Their nets and their tools, piled by the sea cave. The naga dragged them into the grotto.

I'm not sending anyone else in there. I'm sending you.

quests.title: Hetaera
quests.description:
Rukka's crew went into Hetaera's Grotto under the Clutch and didn't come out. The naga keep a hydra down there, Hetaera, and they feed her.

Rukka wants the hydra dead before she feeds anyone else.
quests.accept_text: The grotto's the sea cave in the crag on Hetaera's Clutch. Hetaera keeps to a deep pool off the second turn of the spiral. You'll want people with you, because a lot of heads means a lot of bites.
quests.turn_in_text:
So the hydra's dead, and that's good.

I'll carve my crew's names on the crane. They lifted more than anyone, and they'd want it there.

quests.title: Keepsakes of the Highborne
quests.description: Magister Brightspire says the Eldarath Shades are looking for things they lost: rings, combs, lockets. The Conclave wants them, because every one has a name on it, and the names are its history. The orcs call it robbing graves, and the newcomers on the crews call it archaeology.
quests.accept_text: The Eldarath Shades walk the ruins round the dig. Take what they carry. I'll write down every name, and then the orcs will write them down too, and then we'll argue.
quests.turn_in_text:
This one belonged to a scribe. This one to a child.

We forget they were people. It's easier to dig them up when we forget.

quests.title: The Ravencrest Records
quests.description: The monument at Ravencrest in West Azshara has the names of Highborne lords cut into it, and the Conclave wants a rubbing. The Ravencrest Shades don't want anyone that close.

objectives.label: Take a rubbing of the Ravencrest Monument

quests.accept_text: The monument's in the middle of West Azshara, east of the Landing. Clear the Ravencrest Shades round it and take the rubbing. Use the paper I gave you, not the cheap orc stuff.
quests.turn_in_text:
Lord Ravencrest's name, and the names of everyone who served him. One of them is a Sunreach.

The Grand Magister will want to see this.

quests.title: The Bound Magister
quests.description:
Haldarr's satyrs keep a Highborne magister bound in the far pocket of their den, and they've kept him there ten thousand years. The Conclave wants him freed.

Brightspire knows what freeing him means. He's asking anyway.
quests.accept_text: Haldarr Den is under the satyrs' encampment in the south-east of West Azshara. The Bound Magister's in the farthest pocket off the taproot. Free him gently, if you can. I don't think it'll be gentle.
quests.turn_in_text:
So he's gone, and that means he's free.

Ten thousand years in chains, and he fought you for the chains. I'll write that down too.

quests.title: The Chamberlain's Ledger
quests.description:
The Drowned Chamberlain keeps the palace's ledger in its flooded archive, ten thousand years of who owed the queen what. Brightspire says it's the most important book in the world.

He wants it, and the Chamberlain won't lend it.
quests.accept_text: The archive's in the Drowned Palace's flooded halls, past the collapsed gallery. The Chamberlain keeps the ledger. Take it off him, and try not to get it any wetter than it is.
quests.turn_in_text:
Every debt the Highborne owed their queen. Every debt she owed the things under the sea.

She owed them a great deal, and I don't think they've forgotten.

quests.title: The Font
quests.description: The leylines under the coast meet at the Mennar Font on Lake Mennar, and Magistrix Emberwind says they've started to pull toward the sea. She wants someone to stand at the Font and tell her which way the water turns. The leylines have been restless since the Integration, but never like this.

objectives.label: Stand at the Mennar Font on Lake Mennar's shore

quests.accept_text: Lake Mennar's in the south-west of Central Azshara. The Font's on its north-east shore, ringed with crystal trees. Stand in it. You'll feel which way it pulls.
quests.turn_in_text: Toward the sea, toward the Drowned Court. Exactly where I didn't want it to point.

quests.title: Wyrm Essence
quests.description: The mana wyrms at Lake Mennar drink straight from the Font, and Emberwind wants to know what they're drinking. Their essence holds a little of the leyline's pull.
quests.accept_text: The Mennar Mana Wyrms swarm round the Font and the lake. Bottle what's in them. It climbs the glass, so cork it fast.
quests.turn_in_text: Every vial leans toward the sea. Even the essence wants to go home.

quests.title: The Blues Who Guard
quests.description: The blue dragonflight guards the leylines at Lake Mennar, and the Azure Dragonspawn won't let the Conclave's tappers near the Font. They're not evil, Emberwind says, they're just in the way.
quests.accept_text: The Azure Dragonspawn stand guard all round Lake Mennar. Drive them off the Font. I'd rather talk, but they've stopped listening.
quests.turn_in_text: They'll be back, and next time they'll bring the drake. Still, the tappers are in, and the readings are what I was afraid of.

quests.title: Azurewing
quests.description: The dragonspawn answer to a blue drake, Azurewing, who circles Lake Mennar. Spellwarder Aelis would rather not fight a dragon, but Azurewing has started burning the Conclave's tappers.
quests.accept_text: Azurewing hunts over Lake Mennar. When it lands at the Font, be there. It breathes frost, so you'll want to dress warm.
quests.turn_in_text: I'm sorry it came to that. The blues were right to guard the Font. They just didn't know what was pulling at it.

quests.title: Magistrix Elaria
quests.description:
Under the Drowned Palace there's a vault the sea never reached, and in it a magistrix who never died. Magistrix Elaria the Undying keeps the cracked well at its heart, and it's her well the leylines are pulling toward.

Aelis keeps the Conclave's wards, and she wants the pull stopped.
quests.accept_text: Down the flooded stair past the Tidelord's throne, into the Queen's Vault. Elaria's at the well in the Arcanum. She drinks from it to heal, so hit her hard and don't stop.
quests.turn_in_text:
The pull's eased, though it hasn't stopped.

She was my teacher's teacher's teacher, you know. A long way back. I'd have liked to ask her things.

quests.title: Pearls with Runes
quests.description: Dr. Okafor has found the same rune on half the naga's pearls and on the Highborne stones in the dig. She dug Iron Age sites in Nigeria for twenty years and she's never seen two peoples share a mark like this.
quests.accept_text: The Stormbay Sirens on the Bay of Storms carry the pearls. Bring me as many as you can. Don't wear them, they sing.
quests.turn_in_text:
It's the same rune on all of them, and on the key that came out of the trench.

The naga aren't just raiding us. They're looking for the same thing we are. Back home in Lagos nobody would believe a word of it.

quests.title: The Relic Trail
quests.description:
Seawater in the crate, and wet footprints across the yard that weren't orc or elf. Dr. Okafor followed them to the shore. The naga raiding the Bitter Reaches in East Azshara have been trading Highborne gold.

She thinks the relic went north with them.
quests.accept_text: The Bitter Reaches is East Azshara's north coast, wrecks and a naga shrine. The Bitter Reaches Raiders carry what they steal. One of them has our key.
quests.turn_in_text:
There it is. Gold and moonstone, and the rune on the bow of it.

I'll give it to both sides at once, in the middle of the yard, with everyone watching. On Earth I'd have called the police. Here I call you.

quests.title: The Sea-Side Dig
quests.description:
The map shows the naga digging all along the coast, and one tunnel coming in under Eldarath from the sea. The marks end at the Temple of Zin-Malor on the southern headland.

Dr. Okafor will want this.

objectives.label: See what the naga are digging at the Temple of Zin-Malor

quests.accept_text: Someone at Talrendis Landing ought to see this map. Dr. Okafor's the one, before anyone takes sides.
quests.turn_in_text:
They're digging from the sea toward the same chamber we're digging toward from the land. A door, both sides of it.

The keys open the palace. Everyone wants in, and nobody's asked what's inside.

quests.title: Tide-Priestess Sel'thira
quests.description: The naga's dig is run from Hetaera's Grotto by a sea witch, Tide-Priestess Sel'thira, who reads the runes better than anyone in the Landing. Dr. Okafor would rather talk to her. Sel'thira would rather drown people.
quests.accept_text: The grotto's under Hetaera's Clutch. Sel'thira keeps the drowned hall at the heart of the spiral. If she has notes, bring them. If she doesn't, bring her down.
quests.turn_in_text:
She had notes. In a language nobody alive reads, on sharkskin, with diagrams.

I'm going to be up all night. I haven't stayed up this late since my thesis, back home.

quests.title: Lady Ssiriss
quests.description: The naga's siren queen, Lady Ssiriss, holds the court inside the Drowned Palace's door, and every naga on this coast sings what she sings. Dr. Okafor says she's the one who wanted the keys.
quests.accept_text: Through the Drowned Court's door and into the Siren's Court. Ssiriss sits on a coral dais in the pool, one fallen column out to her. Don't listen to her sing.
quests.turn_in_text:
She's quiet now, and the whole coast's quieter with her.

For the record, she had the other keys. The palace was always going to open. Now it's opening for us.

quests.title: The Leylines Pull
quests.description: Farseer Thrag says the spirits of this coast are restless, and the leylines are dragging them toward the sea. The Tower of Eldara on East Azshara's northern cape still hums, and he thinks it's holding them back. The spirits have been uneasy since the day the world changed, Thrag says, and the coast is the worst of it.

objectives.label: Listen at the foot of the Tower of Eldara

quests.accept_text: The tower's on the northern cape of East Azshara. Stand at its foot and listen. If it's humming, it's holding. If it's quiet, run.
quests.turn_in_text:
Humming, but out of tune. It's holding, for now.

The elves won't believe a shaman. They might believe you.

quests.title: Imps at Forlorn Ridge
quests.description: The fel gate at Forlorn Ridge never quite closed, and the imps keep crawling out of it into Central Azshara's woods. Thrag can hear the trees complain.
quests.accept_text: Forlorn Ridge is the south-west of Central Azshara. The Forlorn Imps swarm round the gate. Burn them out of the trees before they set them alight, and they've already started.
quests.turn_in_text: The trees are quieter. The gate isn't.

quests.title: The Gate That Won't Close
quests.description: Thrag wants the gate at Forlorn Ridge shut, and the ones holding it open are the Legion's leftovers: the Forlorn Eredar who keep the rite going and the Forlorn Doomguard who guard them.
quests.accept_text: Up on Forlorn Ridge, round the gate. The Forlorn Eredar keep the rite alive and the Forlorn Doomguard keep you off them. You've got to break both of them.
quests.turn_in_text: The rite's broken. The gate's still standing, but nothing's feeding it.

quests.title: Gatekeeper Azgaroth
quests.description: One doomguard still stands at the gate on Forlorn Ridge, and he's the one the Legion left in charge: Gatekeeper Azgaroth. As long as he stands, it'll open again.
quests.accept_text: Azgaroth keeps the gate on Forlorn Ridge. He hits like a falling tree and burns like one too. You'll want a healer with you.
quests.turn_in_text:
The gate's dark. The spirits can rest a little.

Go and tell the elves a shaman shut their demon door. Watch their faces.

quests.title: Satyrs on the Road
quests.description: Spellbreaker Ilanthe watches the road for satyrs, and the Haldarr Tricksters have started setting curses on it, so the carts go round in circles in the woods until the drivers cry.
quests.accept_text: The Haldarr Tricksters come down out of their encampment in the south-east of West Azshara. Break their tricks, and then break them. They're cowards when it's done to them.
quests.turn_in_text: No more circles. The grunt will say it was his idea to send you, and I'm going to let him. The carters are newcomers, and they'd never seen a satyr in their lives.

quests.title: The Shadowcasters of Legash
quests.description: The satyrs' war camp at Legash Encampment under the northern mountains is where the curses come from. The Legash Shadowcasters teach them to the Haldarr, and Ilanthe wants the teachers gone.
quests.accept_text: Legash Encampment's in the north of Central Azshara, under the mountains. The Legash Shadowcasters keep to the tents round the throne. Take them out.
quests.turn_in_text: The curses on the road have stopped. The warlord at Legash will have noticed.

quests.title: Warlord Seth'rak
quests.description: Warlord Seth'rak sits on the throne at Legash Encampment, under a Timbermaw totem the satyrs stole. Ilanthe wants him off it, and the Timbermaw would like their totem back.
quests.accept_text: Seth'rak's throne is at the heart of Legash Encampment. He fights with a glaive, and he'll pin you to the throne if you let him.
quests.turn_in_text: The warlord's dead. Send word to Timbermaw Hold that their totem's waiting.

quests.title: Valormok Burned
quests.description: The satyrs burned Valormok to the ground a month ago, and Grunt Okkar's the only one of the watch still here. The Haldarr Felsworn did the burning. Valormok went up three years ago, when the Integration opened the road north.
quests.accept_text: The Haldarr Felsworn came down from the encampment to the east. Go up there and burn them the way they burned us. Don't leave a tent standing.
quests.turn_in_text: That's a start on what they owe. Not the end of it.

quests.title: Vrexx the Hornbreaker
quests.description: The satyr who led the raid on Valormok is Vrexx the Hornbreaker, and Okkar watched him laugh while it burned. He keeps to the Haldarr Encampment.
quests.accept_text: Vrexx is up in the Haldarr Encampment, east of here. He's big and horned, with fel fire in both hands. Make him stop laughing.
quests.turn_in_text:
So he's dead, and that's good.

I'll build the watchtower back myself, one log at a time.

quests.title: Thunder in the Mere
quests.description: The thunder lizards in the Sundering Mere have started coming up onto the Orgrimmar road, and Okkar says the caravans won't run past them.
quests.accept_text: The Sundering Mere's south of here, east of the road. The Mere Thunderhides wallow in the shallows. Drive them back into the water.
quests.turn_in_text: The caravans ran this morning. Two wagons, and both of them got through.

quests.title: Old Stormhide
quests.description: The biggest thunder lizard in the Mere is Old Stormhide, and the caravan drivers have stories about it. Okkar says the stories are true.
quests.accept_text: Old Stormhide wallows at the heart of the Sundering Mere. When it stamps, the whole Mere shakes, so don't let it put you on your back.
quests.turn_in_text: The drivers won't believe it's dead until they see the hide. I'll nail it over the gate.

quests.title: Raiders of the Reaches
quests.description: The naga on the Bitter Reaches strip every wreck that washes up on East Azshara's north coast, and lately they've started on the Horde's supply boats. Captain Zarga at Stormwatch has asked the Landing for help, and Grunt Mazkar is sending you.
quests.accept_text: The Bitter Reaches is the north coast, and there are wrecks everywhere. The Bitter Reaches Raiders work the wrecks, and they'll fight you for them.
quests.turn_in_text: They'll come back, they always do. But they'll come back fewer.

quests.title: The Wavecallers
quests.description: The raiders don't wreck the boats themselves. The Bitter Reaches Wavecallers call the waves that do it, from the naga shrine on the Reaches.
quests.accept_text: The Bitter Reaches Wavecallers sing from the shrine on the north coast. Shut them up, and the sea'll calm.
quests.turn_in_text: The sea's calm for the first time in a week. My boats are running. Two of my boat crews are newcomers who sailed on Earth, and they say they've never seen a sea do that.

quests.title: Captain Ssarith
quests.description: The raiders answer to Captain Ssarith, a naga who sails a stolen Kul Tiran hull up and down the coast. Zarga wants the captain, and she wants the hull.
quests.accept_text: Ssarith holds the biggest wreck on the Bitter Reaches. She fights with a trident made from a ship's anchor. Don't let her hook you.
quests.turn_in_text: The hull's ours. I'll have it patched and flying the Horde's colours by the end of the month.

quests.title: The Temple Guard
quests.description: The naga have taken the Temple of Zin-Malor on the southern headland and filled it with guards. Zarga wants to know why they need that many.
quests.accept_text: The Temple of Zin-Malor's on the southern headland. The Zin-Malor Wardens hold the steps. Break the guard.
quests.turn_in_text: Under all those guards, a door going down. The naga are guarding a tunnel.

quests.title: High Priestess Naz'eth
quests.description: The temple's high priestess, Naz'eth, is the one who ordered the tunnel dug, and Zarga wants it to stop at her.
quests.accept_text: Naz'eth keeps the heart of the Temple of Zin-Malor. She'll flood the floor under you, so don't stand still.
quests.turn_in_text: The tunnel's collapsing on its own now. Whatever they were digging toward, they won't get there from this side.

quests.title: The Court Dead
quests.description: The Drowned Court is full of Highborne dead who think it's ten thousand years ago, and the Court Sentinels still guard the streets for a queen who isn't there. The sea came up over Quel'Thalas's coast the day the world changed, and the Conclave has been looking for a shore ever since.
quests.accept_text: Out along the causeway from the Promenade to the Drowned Court. The Court Sentinels walk the streets. Let them rest. They've stood watch long enough.
quests.turn_in_text: My grandmother's grandmother walked those streets. I'd like to walk them too, one day, without being stabbed.

quests.title: Seals of the Court
quests.description: Every Promenade Noble still carries the seal of their office, and the Conclave can read the names on them. Thessaly wants the names before the sea takes them back.
quests.accept_text: The Promenade Nobles walk the marble road into the sea. Take their seals, gently if you can. They were somebody once, and they don't know they've stopped.
quests.turn_in_text: Lords, ladies, a court physician. And one name that's on the ledger Brightspire's after.

quests.title: The Weeping Duchess
quests.description: One of the names on the seals is a duchess who drowned waiting for her husband to come back from the palace. The Weeping Duchess still walks the Drowned Court, and the other ghosts follow her.
quests.accept_text: She walks the heart of the Drowned Court. Her grief's a weapon. Don't let her hold you.
quests.turn_in_text: She's at rest. I'll write her name in the Conclave's book myself.

quests.title: Eldara's Guardians
quests.description: The Tower of Eldara on the northern cape still hums, and the Eldara Arcane Guardians won't let the Conclave anywhere near it. Thessaly wants inside.
quests.accept_text: The tower's on the northern cape. The Eldara Arcane Guardians walk its foot. Break enough of them and the door should open.
quests.turn_in_text: The door's open, and there's someone inside who still thinks he's in charge.

quests.title: Magus Valethion
quests.description: The tower's keeper is a Highborne magus who never left, Magus Valethion, and the tower answers to him. Thessaly wants it to answer to the Conclave.
quests.accept_text: Valethion's inside the Tower of Eldara. He'll ward himself when he's hurt. Break the ward, then him.
quests.turn_in_text: The tower's ours. It's still holding the leylines back, and now we know how.

quests.title: Hippogryphs on the Pass
quests.description: The cliff hippogryphs on the Ursolan heights have started diving at anyone who climbs the pass to the Hold, and Gatewarden Hrolm has a gate full of furbolgs too scared to go down for supplies. The Hold's had more visitors since the Integration than in a hundred years, and the hippogryphs don't like any of them.
quests.accept_text: The Cliff Hippogryphs nest along the Ursolan pass, below the gate. Bring a few down, and the rest will learn to keep their distance. They're clever birds.
quests.turn_in_text: The supply walkers went down the pass this morning and came back with all their fingers. The Hold thanks you, and I thank you.

quests.title: The Shadowsong Dead
quests.description:
The Timbermaw and the night elves of Shadowsong Shrine kept the peace for a long time. The Sentinels never left their shrine when they died, and now they don't know friend from foe.

Hrolm wants them laid to rest, kindly.
quests.accept_text: Shadowsong Shrine's in the north-east of West Azshara, in the trees. Every Shadowsong Sentinel there was a friend of the Hold once. Let them go, and say a word for them if you can.
quests.turn_in_text: They're resting now, all of them. I'll carve their names on the gate. The Timbermaw remember their friends.

quests.title: Heartwood for the Spring
quests.description: Springwarden Lessa keeps the Hold's spring clean with heartwood charms, and the old charms have started to go dark. The autumn treants in the forest grow the best heartwood there is.
quests.accept_text: The Autumn Treants walk the woods all over West Azshara. They'll give up their heartwood if you insist. Bring it back and I'll carve new charms.
quests.turn_in_text: Good wood, warm and strong. The spring will like these. Ingrid says back home they'd test the water before they carved charms for it, but she'll allow it.

quests.title: The Spring Goes Green
quests.description: The new charms went dark in a day. Something is coming up into the spring from below, and Lessa has seen the same green in the water at the Sundering Mere. She wants to know if it's spreading.

objectives.label: Look into the water of the Sundering Mere

quests.accept_text: The Sundering Mere's in the south-east of West Azshara. Look at the water near the reeds. If it's green at the bottom, it's the same thing.
quests.turn_in_text:
Green at the bottom. It's the same rot, and it isn't only under the Hold.

Ingrid will want to hear this. She's been taking samples.

quests.title: Sporecloud Samples
quests.description: Down past the deep gate the air itself is rotten, and Lessa wants to know what's in it. The Drifting Sporeclouds in the Rotroot Deeps are made of it.
quests.accept_text: The Drifting Sporeclouds float through the Sporegarden under the Hold. Burst them, and you'll want to breathe through a cloth while you do it.
quests.turn_in_text: The spores are dying in the air already. The spring smells better tonight than it has in a month.

quests.title: Dreamfoil for the Healers
quests.description: The Hold's healers are running out of dreamfoil, and the herbs on the Ursolan slopes are going brown. Herbwarden Fenna wants fresh leaves from lower down. The newcomers who climb the pass bring sicknesses the Hold's healers have never seen.

objectives.label: Gather dreamfoil in Azshara

quests.accept_text: Dreamfoil grows all over West and Central Azshara where the ground's soft. Pick it fresh. If it's brown at the edges, leave it.
quests.turn_in_text: Good leaves, clean and cool. The healers will stop glaring at me.

quests.title: Golden Sansam
quests.description: Golden sansam is what the Hold's healers use for rot fever, and since the spring went green there's a lot more rot fever. Fenna wants every root you can find.

objectives.label: Gather golden sansam in Azshara

quests.accept_text: Golden sansam grows in the forest across Azshara, mostly near water. Dig the whole root, it's no good without it.
quests.turn_in_text: That's a winter's worth. We'll need it.

quests.title: A Totem for Valormok
quests.description: Carver Bennik heard the satyrs burned Valormok's watch out, and he's carved a small totem for the orc who stayed. The Timbermaw give a totem to anyone who holds a gate alone.

objectives.label: Bring Bennik's totem to Grunt Okkar at Valormok

quests.accept_text: Valormok's down the road to Orgrimmar, south of the crossroads. Give it to the grunt there. Tell him the Hold knows what he did.
quests.turn_in_text:
A furbolg totem, and it's for me.

I'll put it on the new gate when I build it. Tell the carver I said thanks, and I don't say that much.

on_accept.name: Bennik's Totem
on_accept.description: A small totem with a bear on top and an orc's face carved below it, both of them stubborn.

quests.title: The Stolen Totem
quests.description: The satyrs at Legash Encampment stole a Timbermaw totem when they came through the Ursolan pass, and they stood it over their warlord's throne. Bennik carved it, and he wants it home.
quests.accept_text: Legash Encampment's under the northern mountains in Central Azshara. Break every Legash Satyr standing between you and the throne. The totem's the one with the bear on it.
quests.turn_in_text:
You brought it back. It's scratched and burned, and it's home.

I'll carve it a new face. It's earned one.

quests.title: Samples from Haldarr
quests.description: Ingrid Solberg was a soil scientist back home in Tromso, and she's been taking samples from round the Hold since the spring went green. She thinks the rot is coming from somewhere, and she wants soil from the satyrs' encampment.

objectives.label: Take a soil sample at the Haldarr Encampment

quests.accept_text: The Haldarr Encampment's in the south-east of West Azshara, over the den. Take a sample from under the tents. The satyrs won't like it, so be quick.
quests.turn_in_text:
Green all the way down. Worse than the Mere.

The satyrs aren't just living on the rot. They're feeding it.

quests.title: Samples from Legash
quests.description: If the Haldarr satyrs are feeding the rot, Ingrid thinks the Legash camp is too. The Legash Felhounds dig under the tents, and what's under their paws is what she needs.
quests.accept_text: Legash Encampment's in the north of Central Azshara. The Legash Felhounds dig all round it. Bring me what they're digging in.
quests.turn_in_text: It's the same green, the same smell, and it's running downhill. Toward the Hold.

quests.title: Tell the Elder
quests.description:
Ingrid has samples from the Mere, from Haldarr and from Legash, and they all say the same thing: the rot runs downhill from the satyrs' camps, and it all ends under the deep gate.

She wants the Elder to hear it from someone the Hold trusts.

objectives.label: Bring Ingrid's findings to Elder Haldor Mossmane at the Great Lodge

quests.accept_text: Take these to the Elder. I've written it plainly. He'll ask you if it's true, and you've seen it, so you'll know what to tell him.
quests.turn_in_text:
Under the deep gate. We sealed it because of what we heard down there, and we told ourselves it was only the wind.

It wasn't the wind.

on_accept.name: Ingrid's Findings
on_accept.description: Ingrid's notebook, every sample labelled, and a map of the rot running downhill.

quests.title: Who Feeds It
quests.description: Ingrid says the rot spreads fastest where the satyrs work it, and the Haldarr Rogues carry it on their blades into the woods. Fewer satyrs means a slower rot.
quests.accept_text: The Haldarr Felsworn tend the fel fires in the encampment over the den. Put the fires out, and the ones who tend them, and don't breathe the smoke.
quests.turn_in_text: The samples from the woods came back cleaner this week. Not clean, cleaner.

quests.title: The Ursolan Totems
quests.description: The totems along the Ursolan pass mark the Timbermaw's road, and Totemkeeper Ungar says one of them has gone quiet. He wants someone to walk the pass and see which one.

objectives.label: Walk the totems on the Ursolan pass

quests.accept_text: The pass runs down from the Hold's gate into West Azshara. Walk it to the bottom. The quiet one will feel cold when you pass it.
quests.turn_in_text:
The lowest one, by the road. Rot in the wood, all the way up.

The rot's reached the pass. I'll carve a new one, and I'll carve it from heartwood.

quests.title: Satyrs at Haldarr
quests.description: Haldarr's satyrs knock down every Timbermaw totem they find, and Ungar has carved enough replacements. He'd rather the satyrs stopped.
quests.accept_text: The Haldarr Tricksters run the encampment's curses, and they love knocking totems over. Show them how it feels to be knocked over.
quests.turn_in_text: The totems on the south road are still standing. That's the first time in a month.

quests.title: Haldarr the Hornlord
quests.description: The satyrs' lord, Haldarr, lives in the hollow at the top of the den under his encampment, and every satyr in West Azshara answers to him. Ungar says it ends with him.
quests.accept_text: Haldarr Den's under the encampment in the south-east of West Azshara. Climb the taproot to his hollow. He'll pin you to the tree if you let him.
quests.turn_in_text:
The Hornlord's dead. The Haldarr will scatter without him, and the rot will slow.

I'll carve a totem for the day. A small one, with a broken horn.

quests.title: Orgrimmar's Hand
quests.description: Envoy Grashak says the Hold and the Landing ought to be talking, and they aren't, because the elves don't come up the mountain and the furbolgs don't go down it. He has a letter for Overseer Durgash. Grashak's been the Warchief's man in the Hold for three years, since the tunnel opened.

objectives.label: Bring Grashak's letter to Overseer Durgash in Talrendis Landing

quests.accept_text: Take it down to the Landing. Durgash is on the high ground, watching the dig. Tell him the furbolgs are worth knowing, and they're better neighbours than the elves.
quests.turn_in_text:
Grashak thinks the furbolgs know something about the dig. He's never wrong about who knows what.

I'll write back, slowly, the way furbolgs like it.

on_accept.name: Grashak's Letter
on_accept.description: A letter from the Hold's envoy, smelling of honey and woodsmoke.

quests.title: Boars for the Hold
quests.description: The furbolgs eat honey, roots and fish, and Grashak hasn't had a proper piece of meat in a month. The russet boars in the forest are calling to him.
quests.accept_text: The Russet Boars root all over West Azshara's woods. Bring me the haunches and I'll roast them where the furbolgs can't see.
quests.turn_in_text: Now that's food. Don't tell the Elder.

quests.title: Word Down the Tunnel
quests.description: The Timbermaw in the tunnel above Felwood need to know about the rot under the Hold, because the Deadwood drank the same thing. Tunnelwarden Burrfoot wants word taken to Pathfinder Grosk. The tunnel's far mouths came down the day the world changed, and the Felwood one's the only one still open.

objectives.label: Bring Burrfoot's warning to Pathfinder Grosk in the Timbermaw Tunnel

quests.accept_text: Out the Hold's west door and along the East Passage into the tunnel. Grosk's in the Lower Galleries, watching Felpaw. Tell him it's the same rot.
quests.turn_in_text:
The same rot. Under the Hold.

Then the Deadwood weren't unlucky. Something fed it to them. I'll warn the tunnel.

on_accept.name: Burrfoot's Warning
on_accept.description: A strip of bark with a warning carved in Timbermaw marks, the kind you carve fast.

quests.title: Open the Deep Gate
quests.description:
The Elder has decided. The deep gate in the Hold's floor was sealed to keep the rot out, and now the rot's coming anyway. He'll open it, and he wants someone to go down first.

The first thing waiting below is Old Mossjaw, the Hold's own chieftain, the first the rot took.
quests.accept_text: The deep gate's in the basin floor. The wardens will open it for you. Mossjaw lies on his bier at the end of the burial halls. Put him to rest. He was a good chieftain.
quests.turn_in_text:
Mossjaw's at rest. He'd have wanted it done by someone who didn't flinch.

You'll have to go deeper. Grothar knows what's down there.

quests.title: Xavras the Gloomtender
quests.description: At the bottom of the deeps, on an island in the fel lake, is the satyr who planted the rot: Xavras the Gloomtender. Everything the Hold has lost started with her.
quests.accept_text: She's at the bottom, on her throne island in the Gloomhollow. One causeway out to her. She'll call her satyrs, and at the end she'll bring the rot up out of the lake. Don't be standing in it.
quests.turn_in_text:
Xavras is dead, and the lake's going quiet.

The Hold will be talking about this for a hundred years. We'll be talking about you.

quests.title: What the Satyrs Were
quests.description: The Elder says the furbolgs remember what the elves forget: the satyrs were Highborne once, Azshara's own court, before they gave themselves to the Legion. The rot is their magic gone bad. He wants the Conclave to hear it, from him.

objectives.label: Bring the Elder's word to Magister Caelin Brightspire in Talrendis Landing

quests.accept_text: Take this to the Conclave's archivist at the Landing. He'll want to argue. Let him read it first.
quests.turn_in_text:
The satyrs were Highborne. We knew that, of course. We didn't want to know it.

And if the rot is Highborne magic, then it's ours, and it's under our dig.

on_accept.name: The Elder's Word
on_accept.description: A carved bark tablet in Timbermaw marks, with a Common translation in Ingrid's hand.

quests.title: Echo of the Queen
quests.description:
At the bottom of the Drowned Palace, in front of an empty throne, something made of moonlight and water is waiting in the queen's shape. The Elder and the Overseer agree on one thing: whatever's in the vault, nobody gets it. Not Orgrimmar, not the Conclave.

The Echo of the Queen has to go.
quests.accept_text: Through the palace and down into the Queen's Vault, past the well, to the throne room. She'll call her court, and then the sea. Go with everyone you trust.
quests.turn_in_text:
It's done, and the vault's sealed, by the Hold and the Landing both.

The Conclave will grumble, Orgrimmar will grumble, and the coast will sleep. That's a good bargain.

quests.title: Down the Deep Gate
quests.description: Deepwarden Grothar has stood on the deep gate for three years listening to the Hold's dead walk around under it. Now it's open, and he wants them quiet.
quests.accept_text: Down the gate stair into the burial halls. The Rotroot Furbolgs were our people. Put them down, and don't hate them for what they've become.
quests.turn_in_text: The halls are quiet. I'll sleep on the gate tonight, and I think I'll actually sleep.

quests.title: Mother Sporeheart
quests.description: Past the burial halls the floor has gone to fungus, and the thing that grows it sits on an island in the middle: Mother Sporeheart. Grothar says the spores in the spring come from her.
quests.accept_text: She's on the big island in the Sporegarden, past the first slope. She'll seed the air and feed on her garden. Kill the clouds she makes, then kill her.
quests.turn_in_text: The spores in the spring stopped this morning. Lessa cried, and she'll tell you she didn't.

quests.title: Rotwarden Kaz'thul
quests.description: The satyrs keep cages down there, a long hall of them, and the one with the keys is Rotwarden Kaz'thul. Grothar has heard the cages from the gate, and some of what's in them used to be furbolg.
quests.accept_text: The Warden's Gauntlet is the long hall of cages past the Sporegarden. Kaz'thul's at the far end. He'll cage you, and then he'll open the other cages.
quests.turn_in_text: The cages are open and nothing's coming out of them anymore. That's a mercy.

quests.title: Thornblight
quests.description: Under the cages is the cathedral the roots made, and Grothar says the roots are the Hold's own. They grew down into the rot and came back as Thornblight, and Thornblight is holding the whole hall up.
quests.accept_text: Down past the gauntlet into the Root Cathedral. The floor's a fel lake, and the roots are the only bridges. Thornblight's on the middle knot. When it's dying, it'll try to bring the roof down.
quests.turn_in_text: The roots are dead, and the Hold's still standing. I didn't know which way that would go.

quests.title: The Rotroot Mystics
quests.description: Deepwarden Ulma says the Hold's own shamans went down after the rot years ago and never came up. The Rotroot Mystics in the deeps heal the rot like they used to heal the Hold.
quests.accept_text: The Rotroot Mystics walk the burial halls and the Sporegarden. They'll heal the others, so kill them first.
quests.turn_in_text: My teacher was one of them. I hope it was you who found her.

quests.title: The Rot-Tenders
quests.description: The satyrs who tend the rot keep it fed, and Ulma wants every Satyr Rot-Tender in the deeps dead before the Hold goes down to the lake.
quests.accept_text: The Satyr Rot-Tenders work the gauntlet and the cathedral. They heal each other, so don't let them stand together.
quests.turn_in_text: Nobody's feeding it now, so it'll starve.

quests.title: What Our Ancestors Did
quests.description:
Magister Brightspire has read the Chamberlain's ledger and the Elder's word, and they say the same thing: the rot is Highborne magic, and the satyrs are what the court became. The Conclave has to say so to the Hold.

He wants it said by someone who isn't an elf.

objectives.label: Bring the Conclave's answer to Elder Haldor Mossmane in Timbermaw Hold

quests.accept_text: Take it up to the Hold. The Grand Magister wrote it herself. It isn't an apology. We'd need a longer page for that.
quests.turn_in_text:
The Conclave admits it. Their ancestors made the satyrs, and the satyrs made the rot.

That's more honest than I expected. The Hold will remember that, too.

on_accept.name: The Conclave's Answer
on_accept.description: A letter in the Grand Magister's own hand, sealed with a sun over a line of sea.

quests.title: The Moonguard Revenant
quests.description: Layla Saleh's brother Mohammed dreams of a knight under the sea whose spirit won't rest, and Farseer Thrag says the dream's true. The knight swore an oath to a queen who isn't coming back. The Moonguard Revenant holds the processional in the Queen's Vault.
quests.accept_text: Down the flooded stair into the Queen's Vault. The Revenant's at the end of the processional. It'll put up its shield and then it'll charge. Let it go.
quests.turn_in_text: It's resting at last. The spirits on this coast are fewer tonight, and quieter.
